digest.component_or_area: event signing and authorship tracking (fsck, seam writer)
propositions: _apply_authorship returns silently when author_id is falsy and require_authenticated is off, making unsigned writes undetectable
fsck authorship tally is store-wide and uncounted, hiding per-environment 0%-signed rates behind other envs' healthy volume
fsck must emit a counted UNSIGNED_ENV issue for any env_id that has zero signed events or only Unknown-authored events, gated to environments that wrote at or after the store's first signed event
_apply_authorship must log at WARNING level when signing is SKIPPED (not FAILED) due to missing author_id or signing_key, while remaining advisory (no write failure)
per-environment signed-rate analysis cannot be one-off scripted; beb1 env b2b5c498 (8914 unsigned Unknown-authored events) remained undetected for one month
